title: LAS/LAZ version & PDRF conformance matrix (PDAL, laspy, LAStools, laz-perf test data)
licence: Test data distributed in repos: PDAL BSD-3-Clause; laspy BSD-2-Clause; LAStools/LASzip LGPL-2.1 (LASzip); laz-perf Apache-2.0
attribution: PDAL contributors; laspy contributors; rapidlasso GmbH; Hobu Inc.
profile: Coverage: LAS 1.0,1.1,1.2,1.3,1.4; PDRF 0,1,2,3,4,6,7,8,10; extra bytes, EVLR, WKT CRS, GeoTIFF+WKT, 390 VLRs, negatives. NOT covered: PDRF 5 and 9 (none found in public test corpora).
notes: Headers of every primary file checked by range read (version/PDRF in each file's 'note'). PDAL/laspy URLs pinned to commit SHAs. title: Autzen classified COPC over HTTPS (range + CORS)
profile: copc-http
notes: Range 0-0 returns 206 with Content-Range bytes 0-0/81123042 and ACAO '*'; the preflight allows header 'range'. Content-Range/Content-Length are not in Access-Control-Expose-Headers, so JS must not depend on reading them (use the COPC info VLR offsets). Alternative that does expose headers: OpenTopography pc-bulk LAZ (see lidar-opentopo-co23-roumelis).
